verdict: HTTP 404 from WSUS. The URL the client is using does not exist on the WSUS server. Usually the SUP virtual directory is missing or was renamed.
fix: On the SUP server, in IIS confirm the `ClientWebService` and `SimpleAuthWebService` virtual directories exist under the `WSUS Administration` site and respond to `GET /SimpleAuthWebService/SimpleAuth.asmx`. From the client, inspect the target URL: `Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate WUServer, WUStatusServer`. If the FQDN or port is wrong, re-deploy the SUP or fix the WSUS GPO.
